summary: Backend API regression passed (15/15). Frontend mobile flows mostly pass, with unresolved modal/gesture automation blockers and one web console error.

ui_bugs.issue: Short press correctly does not dismiss, but long-press dismissal was not consistently automatable in web preview (modal stayed open in one run). Needs manual confirmation on real touch input.
Repeated automation instability reopening/selecting city controls after first save (sheet interaction intermittently fails in mobile web automation).

integration_issues.flow: Focus blocker -> close -> continue to alarm settings
integration_issues.issue: After blocker demo interaction, next modal flow could be blocked due unresolved overlay state in automation run.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error: Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`; expected `transformOrigin`.

action_items: Manually verify long-press dismissal reliability for blocker/alarm overlays on touch devices and Expo web.
Investigate location sheet interaction reliability when reopening modal in mobile web preview.
Fix web console error source for `transform-origin` warning.
Retest remaining unverified flow: blocker snooze 5-minute callback behavior in-session.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: backend consistently projects out Mongo `_id` in API responses and tests confirmed no serialized ObjectId leakage.
Auth/session guards are in place and return 401 for unauthenticated and invalid sessions.
Need follow-up: web warning suggests a prop naming mismatch (`transform-origin`) in rendered output path.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated guest users via /api/auth/guest only; no direct DB seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend test execution was partially blocked by modal gesture/overlay behavior in web automation. Reuse existing screenshots in /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter1 and prioritize manual touch validation for hold gestures and location sheet reopen flow.
rca_of_issue: Repro (focus): open blocker demo -> short press on hold button keeps modal (expected) -> long press automation via pointer events did not always dismiss; subsequent modal steps could not proceed. Likely cause is GestureHandler long-press behavior differences under web pointer automation versus real touch.
